Method of Attack: Unauthenticated attacker impersonates other users to gain remote access
Access to signup tokens sent to users with accounts never logged into
Targeting bot accounts via interactions and emails with 'View Request' links
Password changes by attacker do not generate email notifications
Impacted Systems: Atlassian Jira Service Management Data Center
Attack Vector: Write access to User Directory and outgoing email enabled on Jira Service Management instance
Exploitation of signup tokens sent via email
